Both pass cleanly (14/14 tests, no typecheck errors).

## Summary

Implemented a draft/published switch for posts:

- **`db/schema.ts`** — added a `published` boolean column (`NOT NULL DEFAULT false`).
- **`db/migrations/20260818073030_add_published_to_posts/`** — generated migration adds the column, then backfills all pre-existing rows to `published = true` (so posts written before this feature, including a database that already has data, stay public).
- **`db/seeders/002_posts.ts`** — demo posts now explicitly seed `published: true`.
- **`app/Models/Post.ts`** — added `published` to `fillable`.
- **`app/Http/Validators/PostValidator.ts`** — `PostPayloadSchema` gained `published: z.boolean().optional().default(false)`, so a create request that omits it produces a draft.
- **`app/Http/Resources/PostResource.ts`** — `published` is now part of the serialized post data everywhere (`PostResourceData`).
- **`app/Policies/PostPolicy.ts`** — `view()` now returns `this.denyAsNotFound()` unless the post is published or the viewer is its author, using the framework's built-in `denyAsNotFound()` mechanism so denial renders as a genuine 404 (not 403), leaking no hint of the draft's existence.
- **`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`** — `index()` and `search()` filter to `published = true`; `show()` calls `this.authorize('view', [Post, post])` to enforce the policy above.
- **`resources/js/pages/posts/New.tsx` / `Edit.tsx`** — added a "Published" checkbox wired to `form.data.published`.
- **`tests/PostController.drafts.test.ts`** (new) — covers guest/other-user/author visibility on the list, search, and show routes, plus create/update behavior for the `published` flag.

`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` (14 tests across 3 files, including the new draft-behavior tests) both pass, and `bunx guren check` reports no new failures.
